name: Chile
dek: Quinta Normal, Santiago, WMO 85577. Pudahuel is a separate airport file and is not in this table.
paragraphs: The table is Quinta Normal, WMO 85577, the Santiago station, height 520 m. Precipitation and both temperatures are 30-year counts. Pudahuel, WMO 85574, is the airport file and was not averaged in. Mean sea-level pressure in the Quinta Normal file is blank and is left off.

No tourism page that was opened states whether a tip is expected or how much it is, so tipping is blank. IANA gives Chile four zones. This sheet prints America/Santiago, commented “most of Chile,” and names Aysén, Magallanes, and Easter Island as their own rows.

climate.caption: Reference station: Quinta Normal, Santiago, WMO 85577. The city station in the file. Not Pudahuel.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed. The number-of-years rows for precipitation and for both temperatures print 30 for every month. Pudahuel airport, WMO 85574, is a separate file and was not averaged with Quinta Normal. Mean sea-level pressure in the Quinta Normal file is blank for every month and is not printed.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Quinta Normal, Santiago (85577)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and L, 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Chile at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 120 of Law 18.290, the traffic law, says that on public roads vehicles shall travel on the right half of the carriageway, except in the cases the article lists. The Library of Congress page that was opened prints “Última Versión - 07-NOV-2009” and “Última modificación: 07-NOV-2009 - Ley 20388.” One listed item is marked deleted. A later amendment, if one exists beyond that version line, was not the text opened.
driving.sourceTitle: Ley 18.290, artículo 120, Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Chile, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Chilean Peso and the code CLP for Chile. The same country has a second row, Unidad de Fomento, code CLF, marked as a fund. This sheet prints the peso. The list's published date, in the Pblshd attribute, is 17 September 2026.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone1970.tab and zone.tab give Chile four rows. America/Santiago is commented “most of Chile.” America/Coyhaique is commented Aysén. America/Punta_Arenas is commented Magallanes. Pacific/Easter is commented Easter Island. The climate station on this page is the Santiago station Quinta Normal. This sheet prints America/Santiago and does not put Aysén, Magallanes, or Easter Island on that name.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The national migration service's frequently asked questions. The page prints an update date of 5 May 2026. We do not restate a visa rule.
